book.name: 1 Korenta
book.title: Fiisi Pool koc kaɓɗoh ɓi Korenta

content: Kiristaani hultiɗ
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi yii naandis ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ woyee ɗu, yegɗohi ɗu rahas te po woti ɗu ris amb nga ndengiɗ.
E yegɗoheem na mucɗee ɗu ne ɗu amba baahiɗ findi ŋ yegɗoh ɗu wa ɗah ; ɗu tumohɗi wa findi ŋ woyoha ɗah, kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang.
Ini ŋ koc ɗu eɗ, weɗ jangɗohi ŋ rahas mi ŋ haf fo, weɗ ne : Kiristaani kaaniɗ wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha.
A ɓekuusa ŋ ruy-ruy te ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh a hultiɗuusa findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha.
A teeɓkiɗ ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ jahran, a teeɓuk Piyeer, ƴutta a teeɓukka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci (12).
Ƴutta, a teeɓukka waas yino ini uup ɓo' teemet-yatuus (500) ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci. Raakiɗ ɓi kaan, waaye laayiɗ nga ɓa ɓii pes.
Ƴutta, a teeɓukka Saak, ƴutta a teeɓukka Apootar ci jen.
Wi a teeɓuk ɓa jen, a nammba so teeɓuk ŋ mirndaani, mi yi mand na liir mitaaɗi.
Ee, ñam uup ƴissuut ŋ Apootar ci. Ŋ yeyyooɗi sah ɓeeɗku Apootar, laam ŋ tolfiɗiɗ Janguuniŋ Kooh.

Waaye, ngaŋ baahohiŋ Kooh, ŋ nikiɗ ɓoyi ŋ nik, te baahohi a baahoh ho nikɗi ɓarang ɓarang. Te sah ñam panguk pangki uup wiŋ Apootar ci ɓinooɓi jen. Wa keeh ne ñam panguk haa, e baahohiŋ Kooh wi nik nga so, weɗ panguk.
Kon, wa nik mi, wala wa nik ɓa, ineem weɗ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ɓoo na yegɗohe te ineem weɗ ɗu kose.
Kooh hey hultiɗe kaaniɗ ci
Kon ɓoo jen, ɓoo na yegɗohe ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗ, waaye raakiɗ ɓi na woye nga ɗu ne hulit raakɗi. Ɓa minoh woo ineem na ?
Nik ne hulit raakɗi ɗah, kon Kiristaani namɗi hulit.
Te nik ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗi ɗah, kon yegɗohiŋ ɓoo raakɗi njiriñ, te kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang.
Ɓaatta nga nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultanɗi ɗah, kon ɓoo ɗaliɗ Kooh ŋ seedeeni ɓoo na seeɗe'ɗee ɗe ne a hultiɗiɗ Kiristaani te a tumɗaa.
Nik ne kaaniɗ na hulteeɗi ɗah, Kiristaani namɗi hulit.
Te nik ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗi ɗah, kon kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang, te ɗu ris na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu.
Ŋ ineem ɓi kaan ŋ kosi ɓa kos Kiristaani, ɓa sooƴiɗ.
Nik ne ɓoo ooluk Kiristaani ŋ kipes kii dong ɗah, kon e ɓoo uup miskoh ŋ ɓooɓi jen !
Waaye wa keeh, Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗ, a yi koc hulit ŋ kaaniɗ ci, findi tohri koc ruund.
Laam findi kakaan taamboh ŋ ɓo' yino aassa Adina, hulti nam taamboh ɗaa ŋ ɓo' yino, hayya.
Te findi ɓooɓi jen na kaanohe, sagu ɓaahi ɓa ɓaah ŋ Aadama, ɓa jen, ɓa hey rahsisse kipes sagu ɓaahi ɓa ɓaah ŋ Kiristaani.
Waaye yaa nu nga na mbariŋ ɗe. Kiristaani a yi koc hulit ; a hay ɗah, ɓi ɓaah nga ɗe hey name hulit.
Ƴut ɗah, reehiŋ Adina han hay : Kiristaani hey reehɗe kikilifa nu nik na nguur nu nik na hatil nu nik. Ƴut ɗah a hey wike Kooh Baabi Nguuri.
Laam Kiristaani joyiɗ nik buur po mbaɗna Kooh folan sangiɗ ciŋ ɗe jen, a tum ɓa degoha kot ciŋ ɗe.
Kakaan, weɗ sangiɗi mirndohan sooƴɗu.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne : « Kooh degiɗ in ci jen ŋ yaah ƴaareem », waaye Fiis ci woo "in ci jen" ɗah, wa hooliɗ ne a in ci jen ɗal Kooh yi deg in ci jen ŋ yaah ce.
Kaɗ po in ci jen degu ŋ yaah Kiristaani ɗah, a yi Kuɓki, a hey wike haf ce ŋ Kooh yi deg in ci jen ŋ yaah ce. Jaar Kooh nik in ci jen, ŋ ɓooɓi jen.

Raakiɗ ɓooɓi na ɓoktuke sagu kaaniɗ ci. Nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultiɗassanɗi muk ɗah, wa raakiɗ ɓa wi nde njiriñ ? Te nik ne wa keeh ne kaaniɗ ci hultiɗassanɗi ɗah, wa ye tah ɓooɓi ɓoktukee sagu kaaniɗ ceem ?
Te nik ne wa ɗaa ɗah, wa ye tah ɓoo toonee kiñin ciŋ ɓoo wahtu nu nik ?
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wa keeh ne Kooh-nu-wiis maa hote ŋ kakaan an, findi wa nam nikoh keeh ne maa ndamkohee ɗu. Ŋ fiki ɓooɓi, maa ndamkohee ɗu ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, Heɗ ɓoo.

Nik ne hiñohi ŋ hiñoh ŋ Efes na ɗoopaat-nduuf ci, e taambiɗ kiñin kiŋ ngo tah ho tuma ɗah, wa raakiɗ to wi nde njiriñ ? Kon nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultanɗi ɗah, wooree ɓa nga : « Ɓoo ñamaat, ane, laam kim wa kaan. »
Kinaat ñaañoh haf ɗu ! Wooree ɓa nga : « Huntoh baahaaɗi na yahrohe yahroh jiko. »
Dokkaat ŋ haf ɗu moɗoɗ, te ɗu faɗ bakaaɗ ; raakiɗ ɓi inahɗi Kooh nga ɗu. Mi yii woya, wa joy nik kaci nga ɗu.
Findi faan ci mandan ŋ hulta
Waaye ɓo' miniɗ meeksoh ne : « Kaaniɗ ci hultohan na ? Ɓa hayan na cinde faan ? »
Ɓoyeem ñaañɗi ! Fu sok tisoh ɗah, wa joyiɗ kaan bala wa camban pes ɗah.
Te fu sokee ɗah fu na sokeeɗi kidgi na faaniŋ wa, fu na soke tisoh ɓarang, wa miniɗ nik tisoh bele wala tisoh wiiriis.
Ƴut ɗah, Kooh eɗ tisoheem faani a waaɗ, a na eɗe tisoh nu nik faaniŋ wa haf wa.
Faan ciŋ feruuɗ ci jen ceɗ ɗaloh : faan ciŋ ɓo' ci, na faan ciŋ ɗoopaat ci, na faan ciŋ sel ci na ciŋ cuurund ci.
Wa raakiɗ in ci ɓo' min hot ŋ kehƴi, wa namiɗ raak in ci ɓo' min hot ŋ ɗafki ; waaye moɗ kiŋ in ciŋ ɗafki mandɗi na moɗ kiŋ in ciŋ kehƴi.
Nohi raak siñaariŋ wa haf wa, wa mand ɗaa ŋ caɓni na hor ci ; wuu hor sah ɗalohiɗ na waa hor morom wa.
Wa mandan ɗaa ŋ hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci. Faan uumbsee findi tisoh ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na kee yahka ; wa hulit ɗah, wa yahkissanɗi.
Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na moɗeeɗi, waaye wa hulit ɗah, wa na hulte na moɗ keeh-keeh. Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na raakeeɗi hatil, waaye wa hulit ɗah, wa na hulte riifiɗ na hatil.
Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na nike faan njaay rek, wa hulit ɗah, wa nik faani Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na pesɗe. Faan njaay raakiɗ ɗah, kon faani Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na pesɗe namiɗ raak.
Ŋ ineem wa fiisuuɗ an : « Aadama, ɓoyi koc, nikka pesoh. » Waaye Aadamaani mirndoh nak, a nikka riifiɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a onohee kipes.
A faani riif na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, weɗ koc hay haa, waaye faani njaayi, weɗ koc hay, wi riif na Fuuɗsi hannda hay.
Aadamaani koc, kooɗohu kehƴi, a mahohu mun merhey. Aadamaani kanakɗoh puloh Eel ci.
Ɓi kehƴi, ɓa mand na yi kooɗohu kehƴi, ɓi ɓaah ŋ Eel ci, ɓa mand na Yi puloh Eel ci.
Te findi ɓoo mandoh na yi mahohu mun merhey, ɓoo mandohan ɗaa na Yi puloh Eel ci.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ini ŋ waaɗ woo weɗ ne faan ciŋ ɓoo cii minɗi raak waɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, te ini min yahuk minɗi raak waɗ ŋ ini yahkanɗi.
Ŋ hey ɗu woye in ɗasɗukiɗ wi ɗu inahɗi : Ɓoo kaananɗi jen ; waaye ɓoo jen hey ɓoƴsasse.
Wa nikan ŋ harmban ñep na marak, kulɓi mirndoh kuluɓ ɗah. Laam wa hey kulɓe. Ŋ ndeem, kaaniɗ ci hey hulte ne ɓa ɓay faan ci minɗi yahuk ; ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo hey ɓoƴsasse.
Laam faani kaɗ ŋ yahuk joyiɗ ɓekuk faani minaaɗi yahuk, te faani kaɗ ŋ kaan ɓekuk faani kaananɗi.
Faani na kaɗe ŋ yahuk ɓekuk faan minaaɗi yahuk te faani na kaɗe ŋ kaan ɓekuk faan minaaɗi kaan ɗah, ŋ ndeem, ini Fiis ci woo wii raak :

content.text: « Moo kakaan, wa nde ndamiŋ ɗa ?

content: Bakaaɗ, weɗ maangohaaniŋ kakaan ; te a waas na eɗe bakaaɗ hatiliŋ wa.
Waaye ɓoo corkiɗaat Kooh yi on ɓoo ndam taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗ ɓoo.
Weɗ tah ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, ndengaat tir, ali in kanaat ɗu yoondiɗ, genaat ɓaat ndengɗuk ŋ pangkiŋ Heɗi te inhaat ne pangki miskiɗi ɗu na pangke ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Heɗi nikɗi ɓarang ɓarang.
